data.rationale: The proposal matches the true workflow: Check my bus, then the Service Number tab, then typing the service number, with the service number as the parameter. It leaves out the explicit "Track my bus" click and adds a "Find my bus" submit step that may not exist, but a browser automation could still follow it.
